extracted.name: Bow Tie Pasta Salad
extracted.description: This bow tie pasta salad with farfalle pasta, broccoli, celery, and bell pepper is tossed with a deliciously creamy Parmesan and basil salad dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) basket cherry or grape tomatoes
2 cups creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®)
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a rolling boil. Cook bow tie pasta at a boil until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes; drain. Quickly rinse the cooked pasta in cold water to stop it from continuing to cook; drain.
Mix cooled pasta, broccoli, tomatoes, sliced green onions, celery, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper in a large bowl.
Gently stir salad dressing and Parmesan cheese together in a bowl until evenly mixed; season to taste with sugar, basil, and salt.
Pour salad dressing mixture over pasta mixture; gently toss to coat evenly.
For best results, chill salad in refrigerator before serving to allow flavors to blend.
